faqs.q: What is the heavy-duty NBR lay flat hose used for?
faqs.a: The Heavy-Duty NBR Lay Flat Hose is the heavy-duty member of the Indus NBR lay flat range, for high-intensity duty such as continuous mine dewatering, pit pumping and industrial transfer where a standard discharge hose would wear through. A high-strength polyester jacket and nitrile rubber give it resistance to oil, abrasion and weather. It is supplied in long continuous lengths or as made-up assemblies. See the [NBR lay flat hoses](/c/nbr-lay-flat-hoses) shelf for the range.

faqs.q: What bore sizes does the heavy-duty NBR lay flat hose come in?
faqs.a: The inner diameter range for the Heavy-Duty NBR Lay Flat Hose is on request, because no size table is published for this line. Tell us the bore, length, pump pressure and fluid and we confirm the size and rating before quoting. The standard ribbed NBR discharge hose has a published size table, which the heavy-duty line does not. See our [lay flat hose size chart](/blog/lay-flat-hose-size-chart) for typical bores.

faqs.q: How do I choose the bore for the heavy-duty NBR lay flat hose?
faqs.a: Pick the bore for the flow you need and the friction loss you can accept over the line length, then check that its working pressure covers the pump's maximum plus surge. Send us the flow, length and pump and we size it. Longer lines and higher flows need larger bores to keep the friction loss down. Our [lay flat hose guide](/blog/lay-flat-hose-guide) covers the choice.

faqs.q: What pressure is the heavy-duty NBR lay flat hose rated for?
faqs.a: A per-size pressure table is not published for the Heavy-Duty NBR Lay Flat Hose, so the rating is confirmed with the quotation. Send the bore, length, pump pressure and fluid and we confirm the size and rating before quoting. Stay within the working pressure of the size in use; burst pressure is a test figure, never an operating limit. See our [guide to lay flat hose pressure ratings](/blog/lay-flat-hose-pressure-ratings).

faqs.q: How do I order the heavy-duty NBR lay flat hose?
faqs.a: Quote the Indus part number, or send the bore, the length you need, the fluid and the end connections for the Heavy-Duty NBR Lay Flat Hose. We supply bulk coils or made-up assemblies with couplings fitted and banded. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

faqs.q: How does the heavy-duty NBR hose differ from the standard NBR discharge hose?
faqs.a: The Heavy-Duty NBR Lay Flat Hose is built for heavier, continuous duty such as mine dewatering, with a high-strength polyester jacket, while the standard ribbed NBR discharge hose is rated 10 bar in all sizes. The heavy-duty hose is orange with a woven polyester jacket; the standard hose is black with an NBR ribbed cover. Choose heavy-duty for continuous high-head pumping and the standard hose for general dewatering. See the [NBR Lay Flat Discharge Hose](/p/nbr-lay-flat-discharge-hose) for its rating and sizes.

faqs.q: What is the heavy-duty NBR lay flat hose made of?
faqs.a: The Heavy-Duty NBR Lay Flat Hose has a nitrile rubber (NBR) liner, high-strength polyester reinforcement and a woven polyester jacket, in orange. The NBR resists oil and fuel, and the jacket resists abrasion and weather. It collapses flat when empty.

faqs.q: Does the heavy-duty NBR lay flat hose have any approvals?
faqs.a: No approval or standard is published for the Heavy-Duty NBR Lay Flat Hose, so do not assume one. Tell us the standard your site or authority requires and we confirm what can be supplied against it. The hose is for dewatering and industrial transfer, not a fire hose.

faqs.q: What couplings fit the heavy-duty NBR lay flat hose?
faqs.a: We cut the Heavy-Duty NBR Lay Flat Hose to length and fit the couplings you specify: Bauer, camlock, Storz, grooved or flanged ends. They are secured with bands or expansion-ring fittings sized to the hose. Tell us the length and both end connections. See our [lay flat hose couplings](/c/lay-flat-hose-couplings).

faqs.q: How should the heavy-duty NBR lay flat hose be installed and stored?
faqs.a: Unroll the hose fully and lay it out straight before pressurising, because a hose pressurised on the reel or with twists can kink and burst. Run it along the shortest route away from sharp edges and hot surfaces, raise and lower pressure gradually, and after use drain it, flush it and roll it flat from the far end. Store coils out of direct sunlight and inspect the cover and coupling bands before each deployment. Our [guide to why lay flat hose fails](/blog/why-lay-flat-hose-fails) covers the common causes.

faqs.q: Where is the heavy-duty NBR lay flat hose used?
faqs.a: The Heavy-Duty NBR Lay Flat Hose is used for mine and quarry dewatering from high-head pumps, industrial fluid transfer with oil or fuel contamination, and long outdoor lines exposed to sun and weather. It suits the high-intensity duty where a standard discharge hose would wear through. Long outdoor lines exposed to sun and weather are a typical fit. See our [mine dewatering lay flat hose guide](/blog/mine-dewatering-lay-flat-hose).

faqs.q: What is the NBR lay flat discharge hose with ribbed cover used for?
faqs.a: The NBR Lay Flat Discharge Hose, Ribbed Cover is a nitrile rubber lay flat hose for dewatering, pump discharge and general water transfer where oil, fuel residue or abrasion would shorten the life of PVC layflat. Uses include construction and mine dewatering, tank cleaning, industrial wash-down and agricultural irrigation. The ribbed cover takes the wear when the hose is dragged. See the [NBR lay flat hoses](/c/nbr-lay-flat-hoses) shelf for the range.

faqs.q: What sizes does the NBR lay flat discharge hose come in?
faqs.a: The NBR Lay Flat Discharge Hose lists 10 sizes from 1-1/2" to 12", with inside diameters from 39 mm to 305 mm. Wall runs 2 to 4.5 mm and weight 0.32 to 5.4 kg per metre. 1" is available to order. See our [lay flat hose size chart](/blog/lay-flat-hose-size-chart).

faqs.q: How do I choose the bore of the NBR lay flat discharge hose?
faqs.a: Pick the bore for the flow you need and the friction loss you can accept over the line length, then check that its 10 bar working pressure covers the pump's maximum plus surge. Send us the flow, length and pump and we size it. The 10 sizes run from 39 mm to 305 mm inside diameter. Our [guide to flow and friction loss](/blog/lay-flat-hose-flow-and-friction-loss) explains the sums.

faqs.q: What pressure is the NBR lay flat discharge hose rated for?
faqs.a: The NBR Lay Flat Discharge Hose is rated 10 bar (150 psi) working and 30 bar (450 psi) burst in every size from 1-1/2" to 12", a 3:1 safety factor. Operating temperature is -20 °C to +80 °C. Burst pressure is a test figure, never an operating limit. See our [guide to lay flat hose pressure ratings](/blog/lay-flat-hose-pressure-ratings).

faqs.q: How do I read the Indus part number for the NBR lay flat discharge hose?
faqs.a: The last three digits of the Indus part number give the nominal bore in millimetres. IH-LF-NBR-040 has a 39 mm inside diameter, IH-LF-NBR-100 a 104 mm inside diameter and IH-LF-NBR-300 a 305 mm inside diameter. Quote the part number with the length and end connections.

faqs.q: Should I choose NBR or PVC lay flat hose for the discharge line?
faqs.a: Choose NBR for dewatering pumps, oily water and dragged lines, because it resists oil, fuel residue and abrasion and is rated 10 bar in every size here. PVC layflat is lighter and cheaper for clean, low-pressure water. The ribbed NBR cover is made for lines that are dragged. Our [guide to TPU, NBR and PVC lay flat hose](/blog/tpu-vs-nbr-vs-pvc-lay-flat-hose) compares them.

faqs.q: What is the NBR lay flat discharge hose made of?
faqs.a: The NBR Lay Flat Discharge Hose has an oil-resistant NBR (nitrile rubber) tube, circular-woven polyester reinforcement and an NBR cover with longitudinal ribs for abrasion resistance, in black. It collapses flat when empty. Temperature range is -20 °C to +80 °C.

faqs.q: What tensile strength and test data does the NBR discharge hose have?
faqs.a: The NBR Lay Flat Discharge Hose lists a tensile strength for each size, from 3,500 kg at 39 mm to 66,100 kg at 305 mm, and a 30 bar burst pressure in every size. The Sizes & Part Numbers table gives bore, wall, weight and tensile strength for all 10 sizes. No fire-service or other approval is published.

faqs.q: What lengths and couplings are available for the NBR lay flat discharge hose?
faqs.a: The NBR Lay Flat Discharge Hose is supplied in lengths up to 200 m, or as made-up assemblies with camlock, Storz, Bauer or threaded couplings. We cut to length and fit the couplings you specify, secured with bands or expansion-ring fittings sized to the hose. Tell us the length and both end connections. See our [lay flat hose couplings](/c/lay-flat-hose-couplings).

faqs.q: How should the NBR lay flat discharge hose be installed and cared for?
faqs.a: Unroll the hose fully and lay it out straight before pressurising, because a hose pressurised on the reel or with twists can kink and burst. Raise and lower pressure gradually, because closing a valve suddenly on a long line causes a surge that can exceed the working pressure. After use drain and flush it, roll it flat from the far end, and store it out of direct sunlight. Our [guide to why lay flat hose fails](/blog/why-lay-flat-hose-fails) covers the common causes.

faqs.q: Where is the NBR lay flat discharge hose used?
faqs.a: The NBR Lay Flat Discharge Hose is used for construction and mine dewatering, tank cleaning, industrial wash-down and agricultural irrigation, and for pump discharge where oil or abrasion would wear PVC layflat. The ribbed cover suits lines that are dragged over rough ground. The -20 °C to +80 °C range suits Gulf outdoor use. See our [construction dewatering hose guide](/blog/construction-dewatering-hose-gcc).
